import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputStream inputStream = System.in;
        OutputStream outputStream = System.out;
        FastScanner in = new FastScanner(inputStream);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(outputStream);
        new Solver().solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        private final InputStream stream;

        public FastScanner(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            try {
                int c;
                do {
                    c = stream.read();
                } while (c <= ' ' && c != -1);

                int sign = 1;
                if (c == '-') {
                    sign = -1;
                    c = stream.read();
                }

                int result = 0;
                while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    result = result * 10 + (c - '0');
                    c = stream.read();
                }
                return result * sign;
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
    }

    static class Solver {
        final Mod mod = new Mod();
        int n;
        int m;

        public void solve(FastScanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            n = in.nextInt();
            m = in.nextInt();
            mod.ensureFactorial(n + m);

            long phaseSize = 1;
            long p = 1;
            for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
                p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
                phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
            }

            long answer = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                long sign = mod.paritySign(k + 1);
                long numPhases = mod.div(m + k, k);
                long term = mod.mult(sign, mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
                answer = mod.add(answer, term);
            }

            out.println(answer);
        }
    }

    static class Mod {
        static final long MOD = 998244353L;

        int[] fact = new int[128];
        int[] invFact = new int[128];
        int factSize = 1;
        int invFactSize = 1;

        Mod() {
            fact[0] = 1;
            invFact[0] = 1;
        }

        void ensureFactorial(int n) {
            if (n < 0) {
                return;
            }
            if (fact.length <= n) {
                fact = Arrays.copyOf(fact, Math.max(n + 1, fact.length * 2));
            }
            if (invFact.length <= n) {
                invFact = Arrays.copyOf(invFact, Math.max(n + 1, invFact.length * 2));
            }

            while (factSize <= n) {
                fact[factSize] = (int) ((long) fact[factSize - 1] * factSize % MOD);
                factSize++;
            }

            if (invFactSize <= n) {
                invFact[n] = (int) modPow(fact[n], MOD - 2);
                for (int i = n - 1; i >= invFactSize; i--) {
                    invFact[i] = (int) ((long) invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD);
                }
                invFactSize = n + 1;
            }
        }

        long fact(int n) {
            ensureFactorial(n);
            return fact[n];
        }

        long invFact(int n) {
            ensureFactorial(n);
            return invFact[n];
        }

        long smallInv(int n) {
            return invFact(n) * fact(n - 1) % MOD;
        }

        long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (r < 0 || n < r) {
                return 0;
            }
            return fact(n) * invFact(r) % MOD * invFact(n - r) % MOD;
        }

        long paritySign(long k) {
            return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
        }

        long add(long a, long b) {
            long v = a + b;
            return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
        }

        long mult(long a, long b) {
            return (a * b) % MOD;
        }

        long mult(long... x) {
            long r = 1;
            for (long a : x) {
                r = mult(r, a);
            }
            return r;
        }

        long div(long a, long b) {
            return mult(a, modPow(b % MOD, MOD - 2));
        }

        long modPow(long a, long e) {
            long r = 1;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                    r = r * a % MOD;
                }
                a = a * a % MOD;
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return r;
        }
    }
